purpose: Build a long-history Growth × Inflation state classifier using only official underlying macro series with one homogeneous definition across the 1928-present primary sample.
hard_rules: No ETF or asset-return series may be loaded by the Phase 1 classifier.
No conditioned equity, bond, bill or gold outcomes may be computed before this preregistration is frozen.
Do not change the primary source definitions, scoring weights, lookback, thresholds or timing after asset-conditioned results are viewed.
HMRA-v0.1 is a historical structural analogue, not V6.6 and not a retroactive reconstruction of V6.6.
Era labels and absolute inflation buckets are diagnostics only and may not alter HMRA state assignments or portfolio weights.

growth.provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
growth.description: Total Industrial Production Index, seasonally adjusted

inflation.description: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted
inflation.transport: BLS Public Data API v1, POST in <=10-year chunks
inflation.retrieval_note: The BLS flat-file host returned HTTP 403 to GitHub Actions. The official unregistered v1 API is used instead; series identity remains CUUR0000SA0.

primary_analysis_window.reason: Damodaran primary underlying asset-return history begins in 1928; completed-year macro states through 2025 are available without a post-2020 source splice.

annual_observation_rule.level_observation: December level for each calendar year
annual_observation_rule.missing_december_policy: fail the year closed; do not substitute annual average or another month

score_rule.reference_window_semantics: Trailing completed annual observations strictly before year t; current year t is excluded from its own normalization reference window.
score_rule.zero_std_policy: axis score is missing for that year; do not inject zero or epsilon
score_rule.rationale: Five annual observations approximate the five-year macro normalization horizon used by V6.6's monthly macro path while preserving a transparent historical analogue. Ten years is a predeclared state-stability sensitivity only.

absolute_inflation_overlay.role: diagnostic higher-order inflation regime only; never changes the HMRA grid

structural_same_year.mapping: HMRA state_t vs asset total return_t

strict_causal_primary.rationale: December t macro observations are published during early t+1. Applying them only to full calendar year t+2 guarantees the entire evaluated year begins after the information was observable.

phase1_allowed_outputs: annual December IP and CPI levels
annual IP growth and CPI inflation rates

long_history_extension.role: secondary robustness after the primary 1928-present official-series analysis is frozen
long_history_extension.note: The 1870-1918 extension requires a separately frozen mapping using JST real activity/CPI. It must not be silently spliced into HMRA-v0.1 primary states.
